A homeless puppy walked slowly in the darkness. The puppy was hopeful when he saw a house with lights shining brightly. A cheerful girl saw the puppy and spoke kindly. The puppy wagged his tail and barked softly. The girl carefully gave the puppy some milk. The puppy was no longer helpless and was thankful for the girl’s goodness.
